# Таксономия ошибок и наблюдаемость операций

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P12/phase.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Design

detailed

## Goal

`RAG:—` API уже имеет safe `ApiError`, `requestId` и envelope, но
не имеет category/path/retryability/correlation. Пакеты владеют
типизированными отказами, но `Unavailable`/`ScopeDenied` местами
смешивают разные действия клиента. Long-operation seam нет.
Имперсонация уже имеет TTL/revocation и три write-guard слоя, но
direct audit callers могут не записать staff/target/reason.

`RAG:✅` Perplexity MCP + official primary-source verification подтвердили:
RFC 9457 не делает human detail machine contract; OTel async causality
требует propagated context + link at span creation; messaging conventions
остаются Development; metric attributes обязаны быть bounded. GCP/AWS
подтверждают dual identity, source identity и expiry/revocation; запрет
nested CoreX sessions остаётся локальным security decision.

> **Контракт фазы.** Потребляет P5 envelope/DeliveryHealth,
> P6 zone gate и итоговую P9 impersonation structure. Производит:
> descriptor-based error vocabulary без base hierarchy; пять различимых
> unavailability reasons; result/exception policy; internal API projection без
> wire change; typed operation lifecycle; PSR-3/optional OTel bridge; executable
> cardinality rule; complete impersonation audit snapshot.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: public-contract
> Integration Seams: public-error-codes · request-correlation · operation-lifecycle · messaging-trace-context · logs-and-metrics · audit-records · impersonation
> Live or Irreversible: no
> Audit Intent: direct-close-eligible
> Rationale: additive public vocabulary is full-reviewed; adapters are isolated;
> security/audit and final ratchet items are full-reviewed. P12.8 assembles final proof.

## DoR

- [x] Error stability, path/retry semantics and message non-contract are defined in §1.
- [x] Five unavailability meanings have distinct values and category/action table.
- [x] Existing API envelope is explicitly frozen until P13 (D61).
- [x] Cardinality is a rejecting allow-list, not prose (D62).
- [x] OTel Development convention is pinned and optional (D63).
- [x] Every impersonation invariant is marked existing vs P12 action in §7.
- [x] P5/P6/P9 dependencies and within-phase order are explicit.
- [x] Every item names normative paragraphs and stays at ≤8 Files / ≤14 Required Reads.

## Scope Included

`ErrorCategory`, `UnavailabilityReason`, `ErrorDescriptor`, `DescribesError`; stable-code
compatibility and result-vs-exception article; additive API metadata/correlation with old wire
shape; measured attributes error split; typed start/completed/failed observation; null, PSR-3
and optional OTel adapters; W3C trace carrier in existing P5 metadata and consumer span link;
aggregate P5 health metrics; exact metric dimension allow-list; synchronous impersonation audit
enrichment; nested-session rejection, reason propagation, failed-login cleanup and expiry/
revocation/write-guard regression; root contract ratchets and release/reference records.

## Scope Excluded

External error envelope, `application/problem+json`, error/OpenAPI snapshots and content
negotiation (P13); own tracing backend/exporter/collector; mandatory OTel runtime; SLO/alerts;
account/contract ids as metric labels; central exception base class; repository-wide exception
rewrite; fabricated entitlement source; DDL; in-flight request interruption on revocation;
loosening impersonation guards; renames (P15); acceptance fixtures (P17).

## Dependencies

P5, P6 and P9 must be terminal before execution; all P12 items still wait for D14 stage 2.
Within phase: `P12.1 → {B19, P12.4, P12.6}`; B19 = `P12.2 + P12.3`;
`P12.4 → P12.5` (recommended B20 sequential shared context); `P12.6 → P12.7`;
all → P12.8. Batches are recommendations and each item closes separately.

## Items

| Item | Purpose | Review |
|:--|:--|:--|
| P12.1 | Core error vocabulary, compatibility/result policy and P6 zone classification. | full |
| P12.2 | API mapping + internal correlation while preserving exact P12 wire shape. | full |
| P12.3 | Attributes proof: unavailable, access denied and schema conflict become distinct. | light |
| P12.4 | Vendor-neutral operation events, null/PSR-3 adapters and redacted failure view. | light |
| P12.5 | Metric allow-list, P5 trace carrier, optional OTel bridge and aggregate health export. | full |
| P12.6 | Universal synchronous impersonation stamp on every core audit entry. | full |
| P12.7 | Tenancy session invariants: no nesting, reason, cleanup, expiry/revocation proof. | full |
| P12.8 | Error/observability/security ratchets, complete validation and receipt. | full |

## Validation

Every item runs affected package lint/analyse/test. P12.5 also proves default boot with OTel
absent and optional-adapter qualification; P12.7 PG tests run only after isolation preflight.
P12.8 runs core/api/attributes/tenancy suites, relevant root Arch checks and isolated PG closure.
Required negative fixtures: code/category/retry drift; invalid JSON Pointer; old API wire change;
attributes message parsing; start without terminal/dual terminal fixture; raw failure leakage;
forbidden metric label; fabricated trace id; missing OTel package; contract/account health label;
direct audit bypass; nested start; failed login residue; expired/revoked session; loosened write guard;
unclassified core file. A skipped optional/PG/security lane is not green.

## Phase Handoff

Receipt records: error compatibility table and stable-code fixture; old API wire digest;
attributes mapping; operation-event sequence; log/trace redaction; exact metric label set;
OTel package/version/semconv mode and no-SDK boot; producer→consumer link; P5 health instruments;
impersonation matrix and direct-audit proof; P6 zone ratchet; commands, failures/skips and remaining
risks. No P13 wire artifact is produced.
